results.title: Silent Roar
results.overview: Dondo is a young surfer. His fisherman dad Willy disappeared a year ago.  No sign of his boat, nor his body. Dondo’s mother and the community know Willy has not survived a year in the Atlantic.  But Dondo thinks differently.

results.title: The Queen
results.overview: The matriarch of a traditional Turkish family tries to stop her eldest daughter’s divorce, only to confront the shifting values within her own home.

results.title: The Treasure of Pancho Villa
results.overview: When three treasure hunters drive into a barren Mexican desert in search of a GOLDEN BELL, they discover their biggest challenge isn't the harsh environment or the local bandits but the darkness in themselves.

results.title: Leaving My Mother
results.overview: A teenage boy gets the opportunity of a lifetime. But to follow his passions and chase his dreams of becoming a magician, he must face his biggest challenge yet - leaving his loving mother.

results.title: Miss Valentine
results.overview: Samantha carries the baggage of having had an onstage meltdown after winning her hometown’s Miss Valentine pageant as a teen. Years later, she returns home following a painful breakup and finds that things are much different this time around.

results.title: Terror Comes Knocking: The Marcela Borges Story
results.original_title: Terror Comes Knocking: The Marcela Borges Story
results.overview: Marcela Borges and her growing family’s idyllic weekend quickly turn into every family’s worst nightmare when masked gunmen barge into their Florida suburban home. With gunshots piercing their walls, a newly pregnant Marcela, her husband, and their young son are left with no choice but to comply with their captors’ demands: surrender $200,000 or their lives. But with no means of accessing that sort of money, Marcela faces insurmountable odds to protect her family from their violent captors and must make the life and death decisions to keep her family safe.

results.title: Odds Beater
results.overview: The film tells the story of Cai Wanjin, a teacher who is frustrated with his career, helping Huang Dengyu, a student who is looked down upon by everyone, to spend an irreplaceable and precious journey in his senior year of high school. They illuminate each other's lives, and both fiund the meaning of persistence in adversity and going against the wind.

results.title: Dwars
results.overview: Katelijne suffers a spinal cord injury in a boating accident. They refuse to accept life in a wheelchair. Katelijne does everything she can to regain control over her body and life and begins a long and complex rehabilitation process with perseverance.

results.title: Bloodline of the Jewel
results.overview: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala's world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of someone's dangerous and deadly quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver, Oliver, who vows to help her get answers. Nahdulay is faced with revelations from her past and newly surfaced feelings, as a series of mysterious and deadly events connected to her family unfold.

results.title: Бабки
results.overview: A father and son live in the same apartment, yet each leads his own parallel life. Matters come to a head when the son decides to leave home…

results.title: O MILAGRE DE SÃO JOÃO MILAGRE
results.original_title: O MILAGRE DE SÃO JOÃO MILAGRE

results.title: Angels Don't Buzz
results.overview: An insurance agent, an accountant, a digital gravedigger, a homeless accordion player, a typography designer and seven other completely different people meet at a cooking class. Father and son are driving a car through a monotonous, endless, cold autumn landscape. Their paths will all cross and life will never be the same again. Ultimately, each of them will understand what it means to be an angel on this cruel, dry, gray earth.

results.title: St. Patrick's Day Massacre
results.overview: On a trip to Dublin to celebrate St. Patrick's Day, four friends agree to spend the night in an abandoned tavern, where they are stalked by an undead killer in search of revenge for a tragedy that occurred centuries before.

results.title: Some Nights I Feel Like Walking
results.original_title: Some Nights I Feel Like Walking
results.overview: In the seedy underbelly of Manila, teenage runaway Zion links up with a group of queer street hustlers who lead him on a heated journey of self-discovery in the tempting and dangerous nocturnal city.

results.title: standby, action!
results.overview: Following the body of Park Kyung-seok and the hands of Moon Jong-taek, the film documents Park's daily struggles on the subway and the public outcry over 'inconveniencing innocent people.' Holding his camera, Moon confronts a wall of indifference as they repeat the same fight in an unchanging world.

results.title: Detective Dee Demon Curse
results.overview: In the first year of the Tianshou era, rumors of monsters and restless spirits spread as strange incidents erupt across the countryside. When a retired official, Jiang Biejia, is robbed and murdered during a highly ritualized ancestral-tomb ceremony, the dying man scrawls the words "Demon-Subduing Curse", insisting a "demon" will return to kill the true culprit in vengeance. Summoned to investigate, Di Renjie AKA Detective Dee traces the crime to a trail of missing relics: Jiang had recently paid a suspicious sum to a mysterious hunchback, Sun Tuobei, for a cache of "family treasures," which are then stolen in the attack.

results.title: Born at Night
results.overview: A rebirth in the middle of the night through the first encounter between Saó and Juliana, where vulnerability and seduction intertwine to pave the way for a promising tomorrow.

results.title: HENRI
results.overview: Gaspard wonders about his grandfather's strange behavior. As he tries to fall asleep, his head full of questions, his sister Ambre reveals a secret to him. What if Grandpa isn't who we think he is?

results.title: The Lord’s Prayer
results.overview: More than a familiar recitation, the Lord’s Prayer is revealed as the very heartbeat of the Gospel: a bold, revolutionary call to live God’s Kingdom here and now. Each line opens a doorway into the world of Scripture, unveiling the cultural, historical, and spiritual depth behind Jesus’s teaching. Through captivating visuals, exceptional scholarship, and powerful storytelling, viewers will rediscover the prayer’s transformative power. It challenges us not merely to say the words, but to embody them—to shape our lives around trust, surrender, forgiveness, and the pursuit of God’s justice and peace.
